cards.example_en: Your bag is similar to mine.
cards.example_zh: 你的包与我的相似。

cards.example_en: Mr Li is strict with our homework.
cards.example_zh: 李老师对我们的作业很严格。

cards.example_en: She hopes to be successful in the contest.
cards.example_zh: 她希望在比赛中取得成功。

cards.example_en: You are supposed to knock before you come in.
cards.example_zh: 进来之前你应当先敲门。

cards.example_en: I am not sure about the answer.
cards.example_zh: 我对这个答案没有把握。

cards.example_en: Mum is surprised at the low price.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈对这么低的价格感到吃惊。

cards.example_en: The boy is talented in painting.
cards.example_zh: 这个男孩在绘画上有天赋。

cards.example_en: I am thankful to my uncle for the gift.
cards.example_zh: 我感激叔叔送的礼物。

cards.example_en: She is thirsty for a chance to travel.
cards.example_zh: 她渴望有机会去旅行。

cards.example_en: I am tired of the same lunch every day.
cards.example_zh: 我厌烦每天吃同样的午饭。

cards.example_en: A knife is used for cutting.
cards.example_zh: 刀被用来切割。

cards.example_en: I am used to getting up early.
cards.example_zh: 我习惯于早起。

cards.example_en: A map is useful to visitors.
cards.example_zh: 地图对游客有用。

cards.example_en: He is weak in spelling.
cards.example_zh: 他在拼写方面弱。

cards.example_en: Are you willing to share your notes?
cards.example_zh: 你愿意分享笔记吗？

cards.example_en: Parents are worried about the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 家长为这场大雨担心。

cards.example_en: Above all, bring your student card.
cards.example_zh: 最重要的是，带上学生证。

cards.example_en: She read the line again and again.
cards.example_zh: 她把那一行读了一遍又一遍。

cards.example_en: Call me as soon as you get home.
cards.example_zh: 你一到家就给我打电话。

cards.example_en: This rope is as long as that one.
cards.example_zh: 这根绳子和那根一样长。

cards.example_en: Both my sister and I like noodles.
cards.example_zh: 我和姐姐都喜欢面条。

cards.example_en: People often compare the moon to a plate.
cards.example_zh: 人们常把月亮比作盘子。

cards.example_en: Do not compare your score with his.
cards.example_zh: 别拿你的分数和他的比。

cards.example_en: Day after day, he practises the violin.
cards.example_zh: 他日复一日地练小提琴。

cards.example_en: We can either walk or ride a bike.
cards.example_zh: 我们可以走路，也可以骑车。

cards.example_en: We will go even if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 即使下雨我们也会去。

cards.example_en: First of all, write your name.
cards.example_zh: 首先写下你的名字。

cards.example_en: You had better take a coat.
cards.example_zh: 你最好带件外套。

cards.example_en: You had better do your homework before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 你最好晚饭前把作业做了。

cards.example_en: There are flowers here and there in the yard.
cards.example_zh: 院子里到处都是花。

cards.example_en: Neither the bus nor the taxi has come.
cards.example_zh: 公交车和出租车都还没来。

cards.example_en: He no longer lives in this street.
cards.example_zh: 他不再住在这条街。

cards.example_en: She can not only sing but also dance.
cards.example_zh: 她不但会唱歌，而且会跳舞。

cards.example_en: I do not eat sweets any more.
cards.example_zh: 我再也不吃糖了。

cards.example_en: We visit the museum now and then.
cards.example_zh: 我们偶尔去博物馆。

cards.example_en: Once upon a time, a cat lived by the river.
cards.example_zh: 从前，一只猫住在河边。

cards.example_en: I prefer tea to coffee.
cards.example_zh: 比起咖啡，我更喜欢茶。

cards.example_en: The fence can prevent the dog from running out.
cards.example_zh: 篱笆能阻止狗跑出去。

cards.example_en: I will walk rather than wait for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 我要走路，而不是等公交。

cards.example_en: Please reply right away.
cards.example_zh: 请立刻回复。

cards.example_en: I cannot talk right now.
cards.example_zh: 我此刻不能说话。

cards.example_en: She spoke slowly so that we could follow.
cards.example_zh: 她说得很慢，以便我们能跟上。

cards.example_en: The film was so funny that we all laughed.
cards.example_zh: 电影如此有趣，我们都笑了。

cards.example_en: Sooner or later, you will meet a kind teacher.
cards.example_zh: 你迟早会遇到一位好老师。

cards.example_en: I like ball games, such as basketball.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢球类运动，例如篮球。

cards.example_en: It was such a hot day that we stayed inside.
cards.example_zh: 天热成这样，我们只好待在室内。

cards.example_en: The more you read, the more you learn.
cards.example_zh: 你读得越多，学到的就越多。
